question: For networks that have more ports in status 'DOWN' with port security enabled than the average across all networks, list the network ID and the total number of such ports. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH per_net AS (
  SELECT p.network_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM ports p
  JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1
  GROUP BY p.network_id
),
avg_net AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM per_net
)
SELECT per_net.network_id, per_net.cnt
FROM per_net, avg_net
WHERE per_net.cnt > avg_net.avg_cnt
ORDER BY per_net.cnt DESC, per_net.network_id;
